newsitem.title: USA: Mechanics Savings Bank says fdic lifts ban.
newsitem.headline: Mechanics Savings Bank says fdic lifts ban.

text.p: Mechanics Savings Bank said the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation removed the Cease and Desist Order in place against the company since March 4, 1994.
The company said its improved financial condition, stemming mainly from its 1996 stock conversion and bulk asset sale, prompted the FDIC action.
The FDIC replaced the order with a memorandum of understanding, the company said.
The company did not provide further details and officials there were not immediately available to comment.
